title: Physical Therapy Rep Completion Rate
dataSources: Pump telemetry (`health:glucose`), lab results (`health:lab`), therapy sessions (`health:pt`), symptom diaries (`health:symptom`), care tasks (`health:ops`).
app: Chronic-condition self-management telemetry — insulin-pump events, A1c lab imports, physical-therapy rep logs, and symptom diaries — streamed to Splunk HEC via device exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=health:pt exercise_name=* target_met=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(target_met="yes",1,0))) as matched by exercise_name
| eval the_prescribed_reps_complete_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - the_prescribed_reps_complete_pct
description: Measures the percentage of physical-therapy sessions that end with the prescribed reps complete by exercise.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which exercise are helping or hurting physical-therapy sessions.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `the prescribed reps complete` on `health:pt` events and summarize the hit rate by `exercise_name`.
visualization: Table of exercise with percentage of physical-therapy sessions ending with the prescribed reps complete.
grandmaExplanation: It flags how often the prescribed reps complete happens for each exercise so you can see where physical-therapy sessions go smoothly or get stuck.
